items.summary: Scoping doc landed at docs/ai-research/scoping/mcts-distill.md (2026-05-14). Pre-existing evidence: W6/iter-2 search-wrapped Wilson 0.6479; raw-policy Wilson 0.1455 at n=20 (Phase J anchor, not a ceiling). Unknown to resolve: raw-policy Wilson at n=1000 from a fresh BC retrain on the existing R13-W6-phase-d corpora (~6216 rows). State-coverage mismatch (mcts-selfplay vs rule-bot gate) flagged as the largest risk.

CLOSEOUT FAIL (2026-05-15): iter-0 SL gate Wilson lower 0.1470 (n=1000 side-balanced, rule-bot, seed-start 9000), point 0.169, on runs/mcts-distill-v1/iter-000/. Below 0.30 → scoping § 6 FAIL + § 5(c) state-coverage mismatch is the binding constraint (the pre-registered biggest risk). Soft-visit MCTS-distill BC is the worst F1 iter-0 axis (-15 to -18pp vs R7/R8/R7.b.2). MCTS-distill SL branch closed. Result: docs/ai-research/progress/r15.md § MCTS-distill v1. Reproduction-from-item17 blocked by post-R7.b.2 arch incompat (see run README); canonical gate verdict was produced at scoping commit 73c2d8c and is intact.

Per mcts-distill.md § 6 FAIL path (Wilson 0.1470 < 0.30 → state-coverage binding, § 5(c)): label-shape is not the F1 bottleneck. Next direction must change either (i) the warm-start — init from W6/iter-2 directly rather than item17 — or (ii) the supervision distribution toward a rule-bot-covered state set (rule-bot-mixed mcts corpus, or DPO on MCTS-derived pairs). The § 6 MARGINAL 12k-regen + rule-bot-mix follow-up does NOT fire (requires Wilson ∈ [0.37,0.40)). Four F1 axes now exhausted: labels (R7), objective (R8), representation (R7.b.2), label-shape (MCTS-distill v1). Escalate direction pick to user.
items.next_action: Scope a follow-up doc deciding between warm-start change (init from runs/R13-W6-phase-d/iter-2/checkpoint.pt) vs supervision-distribution change (rule-bot-mixed corpus / DPO on MCTS pairs). The architecture-incompat blocker (item17 checkpoint predates R7.b.2 card-vocab embedding; train_bc.py strict load_state_dict) must be resolved or designed around before any item17-warm-start variant — initing from W6/iter-2 (current-arch) sidesteps it. Bring the direction pick + the arch-bridge decision to the user.

fp16 overflow at training/uma_ai/model.py:199 — logits.masked_fill(~action_mask.bool(), -1.0e9) overflows at::Half. Triggered when train_bc.py --amp is used on CUDA. Surfaced 2026-05-14 during R7.b.2 first-launch attempt; workaround was to drop --amp. Real fix: replace -1.0e9 with torch.finfo(logits.dtype).min (or -1e4 if simpler). One-line + smoke. Low priority (workaround works).

items.summary: Pidfile race observed across digest slots 18/20/22/25/26 when launching orchestrator via `nohup npm run … &`: captured PID is the wrapper, not the orchestrator's real Python PID. Slot 34's direct `nohup training/.venv/bin/python -u … &` did NOT trigger the race. Working hypothesis: `nohup` × `npm run` wrapper interaction. Direct-python invocation already works as workaround.
items.next_action: When this becomes the highest-leverage open item: investigator confirms the hypothesis; if confirmed, implementer adds `pid.txt` write inside `training/dagger_orchestrator.py` startup and updates harness docs to prefer direct-python invocation.
